title: Why are Muslim soldiers in the Canadian military allowed to wear Hamas jihadi 'keffiyeh' scarves while in uniform?
text: RAIR Foundation In a shocking post on the official Facebook page of the Canadian Joint Operations Command (CJOC)—a government-run military page— an image was uploaded of a Canadian soldier in uniform, weapon in hand, studying a map. But what stood out wasn’t just the tactical pose—it was the Palestinian keffiyeh wrapped around his neck, the infamous symbol of Hamas, jihad, and the destruction of Israel The keffiyeh is no longer a mere cultural artifact—many now recognize it as the modern equivalent of the Nazi swastika, a symbol embraced by those who openly call for the annihilation of Jews and the Jewish state, from the streets of Toronto to the terror tunnels of Gaza.” This is not just an ambiguous display of Palestinian sympathy—Trudeau’s government is now openly aligning with Palestine and Hamas and, therefore, turning its back on Israel and the Jewish people. What’s more, Trudeau’s long-standing war on free speech took a major step forward in 2016 when his government introduced Motion M-103, co-sponsored by Iqra Khalid, a Pakistani-born Liberal MP with ties to Islamist groups. This motion prioritized Islam above all other religions, calling for government action against “Islamophobia” while saying absolutely nothing about the skyrocketing antisemitism across Canada. M-103 paved the way for government-funded programs that enforce Islamic blasphemy laws under the guise of “fighting hate.” Meanwhile, Jewish Canadians are harassed, attacked, and forced to hide their identities—while Trudeau ignores or enables the very people targeting them.
